articles.title: Astronomers Discover Two 'Super-Puff' Planets Lighter Than Cotton Candy
articles.summary: Two Jupiter-sized planets, TOI-791 b and c, are so fluffy they're less dense than cotton candy. They orbit a star 1,113 light-years away and are among the rarest planets known.

articles.title: DNA Computer Performs Calculations in a Single Drop of Water
articles.summary: Scientists created a DNA computer that uses billions of molecules to do math in a drop of water. It solves 10 + 3 in 30 seconds and could one day work inside living cells.

articles.title: 9-Year-Old's Minecraft Channel Costs Dad $118K and His Job
articles.summary: A 9-year-old spent $118,000 on YouTube ads for his Minecraft channel, using his dad's corporate card. The dad lost his job and may lose their house. The story has 3 million views.
